senses.gloss: preparation, esp. making fruits available by separating the tithes, the priest’s share &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:1:7">Y. Dem. III, beg. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>נותן לו כדי תִיקּוּנוֹ</he> (not <he>תיקולו</he>) we give a quantity large enough for him to separate the tithe, i.e. we give him a larger quantity, so that after deducting the gifts he should have as much as is due to him; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:2">Gitt. IV, 2</cite>, a. fr. <he>מפני ת׳ העולם</he> for the sake of the social order.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:2">Succ. V, 2</cite> <he>ומתקנין שם ת׳ גדול</he> and they introduced a great improvement there; <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 5:2">ib.</cite> <he>מאי ת׳ גדול וכ׳</he> what was that great improvement? … The woman’s compartment was open, and they put a railing around it &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 5:2">Tosef. Naz. V, 2</cite> <he>ת׳ הדבר וכ׳</he> the way to set the thing right, the proper way is &c.; Y. ib. II, end, 52ᵇ <he>תִּקָּן וכ׳</he>. Pesik. shimʿu, p. 118ᵃ <he>על שם שלא … כתִיקּוּנָהּ בא״י</he> because I did not separate one Ḥallah in Palestine as was proper; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:5">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>כתִקָּנָהּ</he>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">ib.</cite> <he>על שלא … כתִקּוּנוֹ וכ׳</he> because I did not keep one Holy Day in Palestine as I ought to have &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28:1">Pesik. R. s. 28</cite> <he>שאין עושים … כתִיקָּנָם וכ׳</he> my children do not observe the festivals according to their institution, as they were commanded &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 2a:19">Meg. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>בזמן שהשנים כתִיקָּנָן וכ׳</he> when the seasons of the year were as they ought to be (when the calendar was regulated by the court), and Israel dwelt in their land; a. fr.—<he>ת׳ סופרים</he> the emendations of Biblical phrases introduced by the Sof’rim (v. <cite ref="O00403"><he>סוֹפֵר</he></cite>) to obviate apparently irreverent expressions. Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 16">B’shall. 16</cite> [where the text is largely interpolated].

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:7">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:22">Gen. XVIII, 22</cite>) <he>ת׳ ס׳ הוא זה שהשכינה וכ׳</he> this is a Soferic emendation (for, ‘and the Lord stood yet before Abraham’), for the Shechinah waited for Abraham; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:29">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII</cite>; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> <he>תַּקָּנַת ס׳</he>); a. fr.—[A list of these emendations is to be found in Tanḥ. l. c.; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 84">Sifré Num. 84</cite>; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 247">Yalk. Ex. 247</cite>; v. esp. Frensdorff, Ochlah W’ochlah, p. 113.]
